title: The Punishment of Shemaiah from Nehelam
description: The false prophet Shemaiah from Nehelam sends letters from Babylon to the priest Zephaniah in Jerusalem, demanding that Jeremiah be put in a yoke and neck stock because he has prophesied that the exile will last long. Zephaniah reads the letter to Jeremiah, and the word of the Lord comes: Shemaiah shall be punished because he has prophesied lies without being sent. None of his descendants shall live among the people or see the good that the Lord intends to do.
